title: Librarian: a Wikipedia page, made readable

scenes.say: This is a real Wikipedia page. Every sentence is correct, and almost no one can read it.

Give Librarian the link. It reads the whole page and redraws it: why the idea exists, what it is, the parts it's made of. Nothing is left out, and every piece points back to the paragraph it came from.
The rest of the page follows, section by section, as diagrams instead of walls of notation.
Anything still unclear, point at it and ask why, for the steps, or for an example. The answer grows right there.

And it doesn't make things up. It goes looking for what people have already written and taught: lecture notes from university courses, talks by the people who work on this, the papers themselves. Each is credited and linked, and hangs from the piece it explains.
The same page. The same ideas.
Librarian. Grow one explanation, from every source.
